metadata.scope: Fan mount plates, fan guards, heatsinks, duct shrouds for 25–200 mm fans.

material_suggestions.use_case: machined fan brackets and heatsink bases
material_suggestions.notes: Good thermal conductivity for heatsinks; light for fan mounts.
Better temperature resistance than PLA; suitable up to 70 °C near fan exhaust.
Use for hot-end ducts; withstands higher temps than PETG.

standards_used.name: IEC 60297 fan bolt patterns
standards_used.applies_to: fan bolt circle for 40–200 mm fans
standards_used.note: 80 mm fan: 71 mm bolt circle, 4×M4; 120 mm fan: 105 mm bolt circle, 4×M4.

standards_used.name: ISO 4762
standards_used.note: M3 = 3.5 mm hole; M4 = 4.5 mm hole.

output_policy.openscad_code: Geometry-only OpenSCAD with named parameters, one module, and no prose.

parts.name: 80 mm fan mount plate
main_features: 4-bolt square pattern at bolt circle corners
design_rules: air opening is circular cutout centered in plate
bolt holes at ±bolt_circle/2 in X and Y
plate must be larger than fan_size
failure_modes: square air opening instead of circular
no air opening — fan cannot push air

constraint_checks.message: Fan mount must have a circular air opening.
Fan mount should have 4 mounting holes.
